text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Reported symptoms of overdose following ingestion of riluzole tablets ranging from 1.5 to 3 grams (30 to 60 times the recommended dose) included acute toxic encephalopathy, coma, drowsiness, memory loss, and methemoglobinemia. No specific antidote for the treatment of EXSERVAN overdose is available. For current information on the management of poisoning or overdosage, contact a certified poison control center.
